name: modulation-menu-engine
purpose: Style-aware modulation suggestions from chord progressions. Generates ranked modulation options.
when_to_use: When planning key changes, bridge modulations, or harmonic transitions.

name: wyble-etude-engine
purpose: Extract two-voice guitar studies from existing compositions.
when_to_use: After composition, to generate practice etudes from the piece.

name: Orchestration Helper
purpose: Guidance for instrumentation, voicing, and part writing.
when_to_use: When arranging or orchestrating a composition.

name: Voicing Helper
when_to_use: When choosing chord voicings and harmonic colour.
